title: Reliability Sign-off & Scale Integration

capacity_and_headroom.policy: Operate below the highest tested SLO-safe concurrency and reserve 30% capacity headroom.

breaking_point.interpretation: The first tested concurrency level that breaches the latency SLO is recorded as breaking-point evidence. It is not treated as the normal operating point.

evidence_boundary: This sign-off applies to the tested local environment, dataset and workload. Task 01 data is production-style rehearsal/logged evidence rather than externally verified production traffic. Higher-concurrency SLO breaches are retained as breaking-point evidence.

residual_risks.risk: Measured capacity depends on the tested environment.
Task 01 source is production-style rehearsal/logged data rather than externally verified production traffic.
Held-out validation size is limited by the available reproducible evidence set.
Cloud infrastructure cost is not directly measured in this local sign-off.
